title: Takardar Shaida
key_sentences: Ta kammala horo na watanni shida kan gyaran wayoyin hannu da kwamfutoci daga 2 ga Maris zuwa 28 ga Agusta, 2026.
Ta samu maki 84 cikin 100 a jarrabawar ƙarshe.
She completed a six-month training course in mobile phone and computer repair from 2 March to 28 August 2026.
She obtained 84 out of 100 in the final examination.
Ana iya tabbatar da sahihancin wannan takarda ta hanyar tuntuɓar cibiyar.
The authenticity of this certificate can be verified by contacting the centre.
furniture: CIBIYAR KOYAR DA SANA'O'I TA ZINDER
notes: Landscape A4 certificate with a double decorative frame (drawn borders, no text). Bilingual: Hausa first, English second in italics. Title 'Takardar Shaida' (level 1) with the English 'Certificate of Completion' as a level-2 heading under it. The issuing institution's two lines at the top and the round seal (text 'CKS' over 'ZINDER', given as one entry 'CKS ZINDER') are furniture. The 'awarded to' line, the recipient's name, the grade line, the signature names/titles and the certificate-number line are body but not sentences. The two verification sentences at the very bottom (Hausa, then English in italics) are body text and are key sentences. Hausa hooked letters (ƙ, ɓ) are used. No tables, no lists.
